import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
from scipy import ndimage
BG = np.array([13,12,17])
PALETTE = {
 'pink':(233,169,172),'blue':(150,192,210),'green':(169,195,172),'salmon':(230,177,176),
 'mauve':(193,175,195),'purple':(207,169,230),'mint':(153,205,180),'lblue':(163,199,229),
 'lav':(220,185,245),'pink2':(252,186,190)}
tracks = {k: [] for k in PALETTE}
for n in range(1, 301):
    a = np.array(Image.open(f'frames/f{n:04d}.png')).astype(int)
    for name, c in PALETTE.items():
        c = np.array(c)
        dist = np.abs(a - c).sum(axis=2)
        m = dist < 40
        if m.sum() < 500:
            tracks[name].append(None); continue
        lab, nl = ndimage.label(m)
        sizes = ndimage.sum(m, lab, range(1, nl+1))
        i = int(np.argmax(sizes))
        ys, xs = np.nonzero(lab == i+1)
        tracks[name].append((float(xs.mean()), float(ys.mean()), int(sizes[i])))
np.save('tracks.npy', tracks, allow_pickle=True)
for name in PALETTE:
    t = tracks[name]
    ok = [p for p in t if p]
    print(f'{name}: frames with blob={len(ok)}/300, sample first={ok[0] if ok else None}, last={ok[-1] if ok else None}')
EOF

import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
from scipy import ndimage
BG = np.array([13,12,17])
PALETTE = {
 'pink':(233,169,172),'blue':(150,192,210),'green':(169,195,172),'salmon':(230,177,176),
 'mauve':(193,175,195),'purple':(207,169,230),'mint':(153,205,180),'lblue':(163,199,229),
 'lav':(220,185,245),'pink2':(252,186,190)}
tracks = {k: [] for k in PALETTE}
for n in range(1, 301):
    a = np.array(Image.open(f'frames/f{n:04d}.png')).astype(int)
    for name, c in PALETTE.items():
        c = np.array(c)
        dist = np.abs(a - c).sum(axis=2)
        m = dist < 40
        if m.sum() < 500:
            tracks[name].append(None); continue
        lab, nl = ndimage.label(m)
        sizes = ndimage.sum(m, lab, range(1, nl+1))
        i = int(np.argmax(sizes))
        ys, xs = np.nonzero(lab == i+1)
        tracks[name].append((float(xs.mean()), float(ys.mean()), int(sizes[i])))
np.save('tracks.npy', tracks, allow_pickle=True)
for name in PALETTE:
    t = tracks[name]
    ok = [p for p in t if p]
    print(f'{name}: frames with blob={len(ok)}/300, sample first={ok[0] if ok else None}, last={ok[-1] if ok else None}')
EOF", "timeout": 300}
